summary_zh: 习近平在中央军委举行的晋升上将军衔仪式上，为晋衔军官颁发命令状并表示祝贺。
summary_en: Xi Jinping issued orders and congratulated officers during a promotion ceremony for the rank of general held by the Central Military Commission.
